posts.author: Dutchelm05
posts.content_md:
I have a questing regarding gelatin.

If I have a 300 bloom Gelatin and mix it with a 200 bloom gelatin (equally), do I have a 250 bloom gelatin? Or is some parts 300 and other 200?

Thanks,

Tony

posts.author: Tom B.
posts.content_md:
Gelatin is a really hairy organic mishmosh and Bloom is only an approximate measurement. That being said, the least surprising result would be

that the mixture would be somewhere in between 200 and 300 and, since there is likely no drastic structural difference for the two strengths,

the transition from 200 to 300 would be smooth.

posts.author: Dutchelm05
posts.content_md:
Thanks Tom,

I called the guy from Gelita the other day. He said that if you had two blooms like that it would be pretty much in between but a bit lower in bloom. So 300 and 200 would be about 240ish. He alos said they would blend well.

Tony

Hey Dave,

I do not have 300 bloom gel rather 279. I used those numbers for an easy mathamatical example.

The biggest difference is it is very hard to obtain broadband results using higher bloom. Knox is much easier. Narrowband is easier with the higher bloom. I do like the higher bloom to obtain that yellow gold look.

I have some other bloom strengths that are samples and wanted to see if by mixing them if I can change the bloom strength, I guess the answer is yes.

Look forward to seeing more work from you Dave!

i made two 50ml bottles of gelatin, one 300 bloom ,one 200 bloom ,heated both and made some 200,250 and 300 bloom

index (or BI) plates, The outcome, the 300 BI plate came out aqua blue (im shooting@532nm), the 250 BI plate was very close match to 532nm (for mastering) and the control 200 BI plate(knox) came out gold-green as usual. The interesting thing was the blue color in the 300 BI plate, to get blue in dcg (again shooting at 532nm) is a bonus, as normally to achieve this i would need to reprocess at least this plate twice and also keep my fingers crossed ! :wall:

this dcg hologram was made with the Dip-N-Shoot method .........

Tony if this was shot w/your blue ,it would replay in purple!
